lines.title: Pentalift Pro-Series Hydraulic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lift tables rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb with 24 to 48 in. of travel, factory load tested.
lines.content:
The Pro-Series is Pentalift's standard hydraulic scissor lift table for manufacturing, assembly, packaging, palletizing, machine feeding and inspection. It is built from heavy-duty structural steel with an electric hydraulic power unit and a push-button pendant control, and each unit is factory assembled and load tested before shipment.

Standard models are rated 2,500, 4,000 or 6,000 lb with 24, 36 or 48 in. of vertical travel, lowered heights of 7 or 7-1/2 in. and raised heights up to 55-1/2 in. Options include accordion skirting, toe sensors, portable and semi-portable configurations, travel limit switches, foot pedal controls, remote power units and custom platform sizes.

lines.title: Pentalift Pro-Series Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: A Pro-Series tilt table mounted on a Pro-Series lift table, for loads of 2,500 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
Pentalift's Pro-Series Lift and Tilt Table combines a Pro-Series tilt table with a Pro-Series lift table, raising a container and tilting it within easy reach of the operator. The tilt table pivots on the rolling end of the lift platform for stability.

It is available in 2,500, 4,000 and 5,000 lb capacities.
key_features: Tilt table pivots on the lift's rolling end

lines.title: Pentalift Pro-Series Hydraulic Lift and Rotate Tables
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic lift tables with a manual rotating top for palletizing and assembly, rated 2,000 to 5,500 lb.
lines.content:
The Pro-Series Hydraulic Lift and Rotate raises the load and lets the operator rotate it into reach, for palletizing, depalletizing and work station assembly. Its manual rotating top is secured by a countersunk central cap screw so the platform cannot be lifted off or misaligned during loading.

It is available in 2,000, 3,500 and 5,500 lb capacities. Rotation stop options include a manual shaft lock, spring-activated detent stops and a spring-loaded rotator lock, each at 90-degree increments.
key_features: Top secured by a central cap screw

lines.title: Pentalift Pro-Series Tilters
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic container tilters rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb that tip parts within easy reach of the operator.
lines.content:
Pro-Series Tilters tip containers toward the operator so parts are within easy reach, reducing repetitive bending and reaching.

They are available in 2,500, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities.

lines.title: Pentalift ProAir Pneumatic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Lift tables that run on the plant air supply, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
ProAir pneumatic lift tables run on a facility's compressed air supply, with no electrical hydraulic power unit, and Pentalift describes them as easy to install.

They are available in 2,000, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities.

lines.title: Pentalift ProAir Pneumatic Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Air-powered lift and tilt tables rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
ProAir Lift and Tilt Tables raise and tilt loads using a facility's compressed air supply, combining Pentalift's ProAir pneumatic lift with a tilting platform.

They are available in 2,000, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities.

lines.title: Pentalift ProAir Pneumatic Lift and Rotate Tables
lines.excerpt: Air-powered lift tables with a rotating top, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
ProAir Lift and Rotate tables raise, lower and rotate product into a comfortable working position using plant air. Rotation lets the operator load and unload at the side closest to them, reducing reaching and awkward lifting.

They are available in 2,000, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities.

lines.title: Pentalift ProAir Pneumatic Tilters
lines.excerpt: Air-powered container tilters rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb, with a range of floor stand heights.
lines.content:
ProAir Pneumatic Tilters tip containers into position for comfortable part placement or removal, powered by plant air. A heavy-duty tilt retaining bar avoids the tangling of a retaining chain.

They are available in 2,000, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities, with a wide range of floor stand heights.

lines.title: Pentalift LTNI Lift and Tilt Non-Intrusive
lines.excerpt: Bin positioners that lift and tilt at the same time without pushing the operator back, rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
The LTNI positions bins within easy reach in congested work areas. A conventional hinged tilter forces the operator back as it tilts; the LTNI lifts and tilts the container at the same time so the operator doesn't have to move.

It is available in 2,500, 4,000 and 6,000 lb capacities.

lines.title: Pentalift 10L Series Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty hydraulic lift tables rated 8,000 to 10,000 lb on comparatively small platforms, with a 10 in. lowered height.
lines.content:
The 10L Series is Pentalift's heavy-duty hydraulic lift table for applications that need a high capacity on a comparatively small platform.

Capacities range from 8,000 to 10,000 lb, with 29, 38 or 45 in. of travel, a 10 in. lowered height on all models and platforms from 28 x 48 to 60 x 84 in.
key_features: Platforms from 28 x 48 to 60 x 84 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift 12L Series Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Industrial hydraulic scissor lift tables rated 3,000 to 15,000 lb with a 12 in. lowered height and up to 59 in. of travel.
lines.content:
The 12L Series is a heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lift table with a 12 in. lowered height, solid steel scissor legs, reinforced pivot points, maintenance-free bearings and Pentalift's Pentaflow hydraulic bypass cylinders. A remote power unit and push-button pendant are standard.

Capacities range from 3,000 to 15,000 lb with up to 59 in. of travel. Standard models are surface mounted with straight platform edges, and pit-mounted versions use bevelled toe guards or toe sensors. Options include limit switches, skirting, high-duty-cycle packages and central grease systems.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift IR Series Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Industrial hydraulic lift tables rated 1,000 to 2,000 lb with a 7 in. lowered height and 36 in. of travel.
lines.content:
IR Series lift tables are Pentalift's lighter industrial hydraulic lift tables.

They are rated 1,000, 1,500 or 2,000 lb. All models have a 7 in. lowered height and 36 in. of vertical travel, with platforms from 24 x 48 to 48 x 72 in.
key_features: Platforms from 24 x 48 to 48 x 72 in.

lines.title: Pentalift L-Series 4.3 in. Low Height Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lift tables with a 4.3 in. lowered height, rated 1,500 to 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Pentalift's L-Series low height lift tables are heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lifts with a 4.3 in. lowered height, for material handling and system applications that need the platform as low as possible.

Capacities run from 1,500 to 4,000 lb, with 27 to 36 in. of travel and platforms from 30 x 48 to 48 x 80 in.
key_features: Platforms from 30 x 48 to 48 x 80 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift TL-Series Tandem Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty tandem hydraulic scissor lift tables with an 8 in. lowered height and platforms to 60 x 168 in., rated 5,000 to 12,000 lb.
lines.content:
TL-Series tandem lift tables are heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lifts with long platforms, for manufacturing, processing and distribution work where longer materials are handled. They have an 8 in. lowered height.

They are rated 5,000, 8,000 or 12,000 lb with 24, 36 or 48 in. of travel, on platforms from 24 x 96 to 60 x 168 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift TLH-Series Tandem Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty tandem lift tables rated 10,000 to 40,000 lb, with platforms from 48 x 180 to 96 x 240 in.
lines.content:
TLH-series tandem lift tables are heavy-duty hydraulic scissor lifts for lifting and positioning heavy, long loads in manufacturing, processing and distribution.

Capacities range from 10,000 to 40,000 lb, with platforms from 48 x 180 to 96 x 240 in. Most models lower to 15 in. and offer 50 or 59 in. of travel; the 40,000 lb table lowers to 22 in. and has 59 in. of travel.
key_features: Platforms from 48 x 180 to 96 x 240 in.
15 in. lowered height on most models
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift NL-Series No Low Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level hydraulic lift tables loaded directly by pallet truck, with 35 in. of travel and 2,500 to 6,000 lb capacities.
lines.content:
NL-Series No Low Lift Tables give pallet trucks true floor-level access, so pallets can be loaded without a pit or approach ramp and raised to a working height for depalletizing, assembly and packaging. A bevelled front edge eases pallet jack entry.

Platforms range from 44 x 48 to 50 x 54 in., sized around common pallets, with 35 in. of vertical travel and capacities of 2,500, 4,000 and 6,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift NLT-Series No Low Lift & Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level lift tables with a 30 or 45 degree tilting platform, loaded by pallet truck, rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
The NLT-Series adds a tilting platform to Pentalift's NL-Series no low lift table. Pallets are loaded at floor level by pallet truck with no pit or ramp, then raised and tilted toward the operator for better access and visibility.

Platforms range from 44 x 48 to 50 x 54 in., with about 34 to 35 in. of travel, tilt angles of 30 or 45 degrees and capacities of 2,500, 4,000 and 6,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift Double Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-travel double scissor lift tables with about 43 to 90 in. of travel, rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
Pentalift's double scissor lift tables give more lift height than a standard table without a larger footprint, for moving pallets, products and equipment between work levels. They use reinforced structural steel scissors, full-width hinge pins, guided upper and lower rollers and Pentaflow hydraulic cylinders.

Standard models are rated 2,500, 4,000 or 6,000 lb, with platforms from 24 x 36 to 54 x 84 in. and about 43 to 90 in. of vertical travel.
key_features: Platforms from 24 x 36 to 54 x 84 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift TSL-Series Triple Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty triple scissor lift tables with up to 180 in. of travel for mezzanine access, rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
TSL-Series triple scissor lift tables are heavy-duty hydraulic lifts for small-footprint, high-lift work such as mezzanine access, processing, storage and material transfer.

They lower to 22 or 28 in., with standard platforms from 36 x 48 to 48 x 72 in. (optionally up to 60 x 84 in.) and up to 180 in. of travel. Capacities are 2,500, 4,000 and 6,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift QSL-Series Quadruple Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Four-stage scissor lift tables for small-footprint, high-lift mezzanine access, rated 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
QSL-series quadruple scissor lift tables are used for small-footprint, high-lift applications such as mezzanine access for processing, storage and material transfer.

They are available in capacities from 2,500 to 6,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift Portable Bin Tilters
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered hydraulic bin tilters on locking casters, rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb, in portable and stationary versions.
lines.content:
Pentalift bin tilters tip parts containers within easy reach of the operator, improving comfort and reducing the risk of injury and damage to parts.

They are rated 2,000 or 4,000 lb, in portable and stationary configurations. Portable models have an internal self-contained battery and charger, large locking phenolic casters and a three-position control, with a hydraulic velocity fuse and maintenance-free bearings.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Pentalift Mechanical Bin Tilters
lines.excerpt: Unpowered bin tilters that self-lock at 30 degrees, rated 500 to 4,000 lb, with platforms up to 72 x 72 in.
lines.content:
Pentalift mechanical tilts position parts containers within easy reach without a power supply. The platform self-locks at 30 degrees of tilt, with a foot pedal lock release and a spring-return locking latch.

Capacities run from 500 to 4,000 lb, with standard platforms up to 72 x 72 in. Corner stops on the tilt platform and welded lagging brackets are standard.

lines.title: Pentalift Pentaloader Self-Leveling Pallet Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Spring-powered self-leveling pallet positioners with a 360-degree turntable, rated up to 4,500 lb.
lines.content:
The Pentaloader is a self-leveling pallet lift table that keeps the top layer of a pallet at a comfortable working height as it is built or unloaded. A patented spring-cam mechanism does the work with no electrical, hydraulic or pneumatic connections, and a 360-degree turntable lets the operator rotate the pallet instead of walking around it.

Four models (XPL1, XPL2, PL1 and PL2) each have a 48 x 48 in. platform and a maximum capacity of 4,500 lb, with a spring set for a defined pallet weight range and four settings adjusted with quick U-pins. Corner locator tabs are standard, with turntable brakes, skirting and fork pockets optional.
